scope: Directly viewed every one of the 36 final native renders: 3 matrices, 24 four-direction command/combat/death captures, 4 naturally trained chapter actor captures, 4 actual Codex views and portrait sizes.
observations: Brown headband, tied black hair, short beard, grey-brown padded tunic and back quiver match the retained bottom-middle current portrait cell.

Three matrices show all 32 independent poses without neighboring-cell contamination or conspicuous matte/red fringe. Walking A and B visibly alternate lifted/supporting boots; feet stay near ground contact.

Windup has nocked arrow and pulled V string; release has opened right drawing hand, straight tip-to-tip string and no retained nocked arrow. SW/NE singles preserve shoulder-to-hand topology; far rear bow arm is partly hidden by head/body.

Actual normal-speed four-direction attacks emit the existing arrow, then deal real target damage. Release matches the strike sampling slot at original hit_at 0.42; bow speed remains 1.9. No duplicate programmatic full-body weapon swing.
Recoil, knee/hand collapse and fully prone terminal are distinct in the matrices and death captures; whole bow remains visible. Actor releases after normal terminal fade.
Actual Codex retains the current portrait cell and new walking/attack in all four directions; portrait remains legible at 48,96,192,320 sizes.

Actual current chapter naturally trains zhu_keke, zhu_gong, zhu_qi in that order, spending gold91/wood52 without clock edits or actor injection. Four captures show the SAME naturally trained enemy archer with orange HP bar and current HP60/attack9/range180/speed64 HUD. Fog canvas is hidden only after training for appearance.
limitations: Basic low-frame sprite acceptance, not high-frame animation or exact archery biomechanics. Far bow arm is partially occluded in rear view; release-hand change is subtle at battle scale.

Health bars, nearby flags and fog/stockade hide portions of combat art or the NE target. Immediate frame/source and damage checks plus isolated matrices supplement screenshots; individual recoil screenshots may approach recovery before the captured frame.

Existing oversized environment textures, visible terrain seams and large runtime arrow rendering are outside this unit batch. Screenshot FPS includes one-digit capture moments and is not proof of performance thresholds.
Only source/appearance/routing and basic command/combat scope. Full chapter wins/losses, campaign continuation, long-run cleanup/memory, devices and platform packages are not qualified.
